title: Roundtable № 03
question: What does the cost of care do to the people you serve that never shows up in the record?
for_whom: Clinicians, social workers, financial counsellors, health educators and public health practitioners who see the consequences before the data does.
anchor: Anchored to Season 1, Chapter 2: 41% of U.S. adults carry medical or dental debt, and 64% of those with debt delayed or skipped care they needed (KFF, 2022).
